ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Recording weather? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Recording weather.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Recording weather.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Recording weather.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Recording weather.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpreting? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpreting.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpreting.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Interpreting.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpreting.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when handling? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when handling.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when handling.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when handling.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when handling.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forming shadows in light? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forming shadows in light.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Forming shadows in light.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forming shadows in light.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forming shadows in light.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Soil and its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil and its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil and its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil and its resources.

9. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

10. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

11. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Weather its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather its resources.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
